name: Phil Woods
story: Phil Woods of CoreLogic NZ presented “Smarter contextual marketing using Location Business Intelligence” at the 2017 New Zealand Esri User Conference. The presentation is a useful named example of GIS moving into commercial location intelligence and customer analysis beyond the traditional government and natural-resource sectors.
